Tasks.title: Tasks
Tasks.body: Everything due, in one place: tasks from every area, grouped into overdue, due today, upcoming and done. The engine derives each row's bucket at read time; this page only groups. On every row the task can be edited, ticked off, deferred or cancelled directly. Whoever a task is assigned to may always complete it.
